en: Hetuhetusampayuttaduka (The Pair on Root and Root-Associated)
Dependent on a state that is both non-root and dissociated from root, there arises a state that is both non-root and dissociated from root, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is both non-root and dissociated from root, there arises a state that is dissociated from root but not non-root, by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is both non-root and dissociated from root...
Dependent on states that are both non-causes and dissociated from causes, as well as states that are dissociated from causes but not non-causes,

[other] states arise by way of the cause-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Dependent on a state that is both dissociated from causes and not a non-cause, [there arise] states that are dissociated from causes and not non-causes...

And a state arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is both not dissociated from roots and not itself a root, there arises a state that is both a root and not dissociated from roots, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is both not dissociated from roots and not itself a root, there arises a state that is both a root and not dissociated from roots, and [a state] that is both not dissociated from roots and not itself a root... by way of root-condition.
Dharmas that are not-root-cause arise with root-cause condition.

Dependent on a dharma that is both not-root-cause and dissociated from root-cause, as well as [a dharma] that is both dissociated from root-cause and not-root-cause, there arises a dharma that is both not-root-cause and dissociated from root-cause, by way of root-cause condition … three. (Abbreviated.
Nine for root; ... pe ... nine for non-disappearance. (Full detail in all cases.)
